title: Run
description: Shape of a Minion run document and its per-step children. The run is keyed in Firestore by `date` (the idempotency key); `runId` is a ULID stored as a field, fresh per attempt (F-003 AD-1). Source of truth for Firestore docs (Minion) and the supervision listener (PWA).

runId.description: ULID for this run attempt. Disambiguates attempts in logs/history; the Firestore document key is `date`, not this value.

date.description: Run date in YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Paris). Firestore document key and idempotency key.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run began.

endedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run finished; null while running.

error.description: Run-level failure or abort reason (e.g. "already_running"); null on success.

StepName.title: StepName
StepName.description: The nine canonical Minion pipeline steps, in execution order.

error.description: Error message if the step failed; null otherwise.
